title: Homemade Peach Tea
description: This peach tea is an easy, elegant, fresh fruit-infused iced beverage sweetened with simple syrup for a delicious and refreshing summertime drink.
ingredients: 2 slices fresh peach, or more to taste

steps.text: Make syrup: Mix together water, sugar, and peach slices in a small pot; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium and simmer, crushing peach slices as you stir, until sugar is dissolved, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat, cover, and allow peaches to infuse syrup, about 30 minutes. Strain to remove peach slices.
Make tea: Bring water to a boil in a medium pot. Remove from heat and add tea bags; cover and steep for about 5 minutes.
Remove tea bags from the pot and pour in syrup. Cool to room temperature, then refrigerate until ready to serve.
